observations: The page number «( 22 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no footnotes and no signature.

L01-L05: addition of fractions: the places set under one another; where sixty or more collect in a place, what is left above sixty stays there, and of each sixty one is made and set in the place above. L05-L19: subtraction: begin at the highest place and take each place from the one above it; where a place has less than is to be taken, or a circle, one is taken from the place above and becomes sixty parts of the fraction worked with; where the place above holds a circle too, one is taken from the next place up and brought down in the same way. L20-L24: doubling: begin at the highest place, then the next; where a place collects more than its parts, the excess stays and one is lifted to the place above. L24-L27: halving: begin at the lowest place, then the next; a one found there is treated as explained at the beginning of the book. L27-L33: other fractions, quarters and sevenths, are multiplied and divided as minutes and seconds; an example is promised. The page ends in the course of the sentence.

L05: the vertical bar in «unum.|Ponemus», set close to the point before it and the word after it, marks the beginning of fol. 109 verso of the manuscript, which the note in the left margin, «car. 109 verso.», names; transcribed as a margin note. L05: «superiora (sic)»: the edition marks the form with «(sic)» in italics. L13 «inperfectam» and L31 «deus», with a small d (p. 17, L22, has «Deus»), are transcribed as printed.

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): with a space before the mark, L09 «ea :» (21 px), L21 «altiori :» (12 px) and L26 «quentem :» (21 px). L05 «differentia:» and L18 «uolueris;» (7 px) are set close. L13 «inperfectam: et» (13 px, the median word space of the line 16 px) and L31 «uoluerit. Et» (12 to 14 px, median 18 px) have a space. L27 is set close throughout, its word spaces 8 to 10 px; the words are transcribed with spaces. A speck between «.lx.» and «unum» (L05) and a pencil mark after the comma of L09 «uolueris,» shorten the measured gaps; the gaps to the next word are 19 px.

L09: «ea :» is a printed colon, to which a reader has added a light tail in pencil (darkest pixel 136); the semicolons of L02, L04, L07, L10, L11, L12, L18, L25 and L31 have printed tails (darkest pixel 44 to 69). L12: a faint dot after «eo» (darkest pixel above 90), lighter than the print, is not transcribed.
